Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We tabbed to every element, pressed Enter or Space on each custom control, and looked for anything a mouse can use that the keyboard cannot; we found nothing a keyboard user would miss. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: Individual keystrokes do not require specific timings for activation of functionality.
